Choose the correct one-word substitute for:

'A person who is fond of luxury and indulgence in sensual pleasures'.
solution: The correct answer is: **Sybarite**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"Sybarite"** refers to a person who is fond of luxury and indulgence in sensual pleasures. (ऐश्वर्य और इंद्रिय सुखों का प्रेमी) • **Example:** The wealthy businessman lived like a sybarite, surrounding himself with every luxury imaginable. • **Explanation:** A sybarite is someone who seeks pleasure and comfort and tends to enjoy a lavish lifestyle. (ऐश्वर्य और विलासिता का आनंद लेने वाला व्यक्ति) • **Example:** She spent her vacation at a luxurious spa, indulging in sybaritic pleasures. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Sybarite**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Stoic **(संतोषी): A person who can endure pain or hardship without showing their feelings or complaining. • **Example:** Despite losing everything in the fire, he remained stoic and focused on rebuilding his life. • **Aesthete **(सौंदर्य प्रेमी): A person who has a special appreciation of art and beauty. • **Example:** As an aesthete, she spent hours admiring the artwork in the gallery. • **Ascetic **(त्यागी): A person who practices severe self-discipline and abstains from all forms of indulgence, typically for religious reasons. • **Example:** The monk led an ascetic life, renouncing all material possessions and comforts. 44:T927, The correct answer is** option 2.**
